neighbours.label: Determiner or quantifier opening the object of a verb of giving, paying or granting access ('access to all the', 'pay their fair share', 'granted the burgesses their town'), vs the same object without that determiner
fire: Members get early access to all the new episodes before release.
Big companies should pay their fair share of local taxes.
The duke granted the monks their land in return for prayers.
Subscribers will have access to all the archived articles.
Everyone has to pay their share of the electricity bill.
The council gave the tenants their keys on Monday morning.
Students receive access to all the online lectures.
The landlords were told to pay their workers on time.
